changelog: v0.6.3: Cinematic menus. Secondary screens now use full-screen scenery with dark readability gradients, translucent controls, thin orange selection markers, and restrained primary actions. Mode and puzzle selection are navigation lists with a description plus a separate Continue/Enter action. Deployment uses compact map/mode/loadout/traversal rows over the industrial scene. Loadout selection/editing use an armory backdrop. Settings separates Audio, Display and Controls; Multiplayer separates Host/Join. Service Record shows real kills/wins/accuracy prominently with full stats in expandable sections. Creator/chat use a workshop scene; Forge shows build icons, category tabs and prompt first, with History & Tools expanding history, build codes, API-key setup, made-item status and placed-structure controls. Pause and Forge darken the actual match view when a gameplay camera is active. Shared StencilStyle menu theme (bundled heading typography, flat dark surfaces, orange actions, clear focus, readable body text) across loadout picker/editor, settings, remapping, service record, multiplayer, mod creator, Forge, puzzle selector, sandbox, update dialogs, legacy TD/Zombies setup and scoreboard. Forge keeps a 27% right margin on wide viewports (>=1100px) so the match/scenery stays visible.
